name: Riblah

related_people.name: Jehoahaz
related_people.role: Judah's king, put in chains here by Pharaoh Neco

related_people.name: Seraiah
related_people.role: Jerusalem's chief priest, executed here by the king of Babylon

related_people.name: Zedekiah
related_people.role: Judah's last king, blinded here after his sons were killed before him

description: A town in Syria used as a military headquarters by Egyptian and Babylonian kings. It was at Riblah that Nebuchadnezzar had King Zedekiah's sons killed before his eyes, then blinded him (2 Kings 25:6-7), and later executed a group of Judah's remaining leaders and priests, including Seraiah, brought there from captured Jerusalem (2 Kings 25:18-21).
